learning_outcomes.text: Ability to work efficiently in intra-disciplinary teams.
Knowledge about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and security at universal and societal dimensions and the problems that are reflected in the engineering field of the era.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Steam Systems, Importance of Energy Efficiency, Concepts Related to the Subject
Formation and Characteristics of Steam, Steam Table
Heat Transfer, Factors Hindering Heat Transfer, and Indirect Heating Processes with Steam
Flash Steam Formation and Energy Saving Applications with Flash Steam
Equipment in Steam Systems and Design of Steam Distribution Lines
Equipment in Steam Systems and Design of Steam Distribution Lines (continued)
Energy Loss Due to Steam Leaks and Necessary Precautions
Removal of Condensate, Drainage Errors, and Precautions to Be Taken
Condensate Recovery and Energy Saving Example
Testing Steam Traps and Steam Trap Management System
Technical Visit to a Facility Using Steam and Featuring Various Types of Steam Traps
bibliography: "Energy Manager's Workbook", British Institues of Management and the Department of Energy, Great Britain, 1982.
Babcock & Wilcox, STEAM/ITS GENERATION AND USE, 42nd Edition, 2018
Dryden, I.G.C. The Efficient Use of Energy, 2. Ed. Butterworth & Co Ltd., 1982.
Efficient Use of Process Steam, TLV, Co.ltd., 1996.
